title: Computational study of H2 generation from BH3 and BH3− with HO˙ radical
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,29121-29131
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA03503E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Trinh Le Huyen, Pham Cam Nam
Hydrogen formation from BH3/BH3− with HO˙ proceeds via stabilized pre-reactive complexes and double H-atom transfer. Gas-phase kinetics show non-Arrhenius behavior; solution reactivity depends on pH speciation and diffusion.
